mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UB_Matching WHERE matching_State = '매칭 취소'

SELECT matching_number, DATE_FORMAT(um.MATCHING_START, '%Y.%m.%d') AS MATCHING_START, um.MATCHING_STATE, um.MATCHING_CANCEL, (SELECT um2.MEMBER_NAME FROM UB_MEMBER um2 WHERE um2.MEMBER_NUMBER = um.MENTOR_NUMBER) AS MENTOR_NAME, (SELECT um3.MEMBER_NAME FROM UB_MEMBER um3 WHERE um3.MEMBER_NUMBER = um.MENTEE_NUMBER) AS MENTEE_NAME FROM UB_MATCHING um WHERE matching_state = '매칭 취소' ORDER BY MATCHING_START DESC

SELECT matching_number, um.MATCHING_START, um.MATCHING_STATE, DATE_FORMAT(um.MATCHING_CANCEL, '%Y.%m.%d') AS MATCHING_CANCEL, um.MATCHING_CAN_REASON, (SELECT um2.MEMBER_NAME FROM UB_MEMBER um2 WHERE um2.MEMBER_NUMBER = um.MENTOR_NUMBER) AS MENTOR_NAME, (SELECT um3.MEMBER_NAME FROM UB_MEMBER um3 WHERE um3.MEMBER_NUMBER = um.MENTEE_NUMBER) AS MENTEE_NAME FROM UB_MATCHING um WHERE matching_state = '매칭 취소' AND matching_number = #{matchingNumber} ORDER BY MATCHING_START DESC
